charts.title: K2-338 b: orbits around K2-338
charts.description: The orbits of K2-338's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-338 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: de Leon et al. 2021 (2021MNRAS.508..195D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DE_LEON_ET_AL_2021): P 3.850614 d

charts.title: K2-338 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-338 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (46, 71, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 186814470, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 38 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min early; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 13 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
